items.title: World Mental Health Day
items.description: A useful date for a coffee morning, peer-support session or community conversation. WHO's 2026 theme focuses on lived experience shaping real change.

items.title: Brew Monday
items.description: Samaritans encourages people to connect over a cuppa and a catch-up. A natural fit for a friendly MHF gathering.

items.title: Children's Mental Health Week
items.description: Place2Be's Children's Mental Health Week 2027 runs from 1–7 February.

items.title: World Suicide Prevention Day
items.description: An annual opportunity to raise awareness, challenge stigma and encourage safe conversations about suicide prevention.

items.title: Parent Carer Wellbeing Hub
items.description: A relaxed drop-in for parent carers to connect, have a cuppa, find support and take time for themselves.

items.title: Spirituality and Your Mental Health
items.description: Recovery College NHFT session exploring spirituality and how it can support mental wellbeing and recovery.

items.title: MIND mental health drop-in
items.description: Oxfordshire County Council lists a MIND mental-health drop-in at Abingdon Library.

items.title: Bullet Journaling wellbeing workshop
items.description: A free Oxfordshire Mind workshop using bullet journaling to help organise time and wellbeing.

items.title: Decluttering for Wellbeing
items.description: Oxfordshire Mind workshop exploring how organising physical spaces can reduce anxiety, improve focus and support mental clarity.

items.title: SPACE Aylesbury Wellbeing Programme
items.description: A monthly wellbeing programme for adults in Aylesbury.

items.title: High Wycombe Community Activity Day
items.description: A community activity day with local partners, including Healthwatch Bucks — useful for discovering local support and community connections.
